fusions.name: Rolling Rebuff
fusions.desc: Rolls into the target from afar, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Barrel About
fusions.desc: Barrels around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds after each roll.

fusions.name: Huddle Under
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and hardens your armour by 10%. An escort of chicks fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Seams Closing
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (62% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
